text:
mike: Quick check - Prospect (FjordBank) wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Must-haves: signed bundle + SBOM, HSM verification path, tamper-evident physical delivery, and a precise upgrade cadence in the SOW. Also asked about telemetry=off support. Who can confirm constraints and pricing?

sarah: We support two artifact types for airgap: full operator bundle (images + runtime + model snapshot) and delta minibundles (model diffs + manifest). Typical sizes: full 25-65GB, delta 0.5-6GB.

leo: Lead times: full build + SBOM + signing ~3 business days after final manifest; minibundle ~1 business day. Physical courier/chain-of-custody adds ~2-5 business days depending on region. Tamper-evident seals and serial-numbered media recommended.

mike: Telemetry requirement is "no outbound beacons" in their security questionnaire. Can we do that?

sarah: Yes, we can produce a no-telemetry build. Tradeoffs: we lose remote observability; troubleshooting requires manual logs and guided diagnostics. Support retainer increases (~+15%) to cover additional SE hours. Must call this out in SOW.

leo: Key management: we provide signature verification artifacts. If they want to control signing in their HSM, we can run a verification-only flow (they import public key) or do a signing-rehearsal with their ops team. We never export customer private keys. Note: signer key rotation will require re-signing active bundles and is a billable operation if done by us.

mike: Pricing model to propose?

sarah: Typical proposal lines:
- One-time packaging + SBOM + signing fee (includes manifest & acceptance checklist).
- Per-shipment courier cost (pass-through).
- Monthly retainer for patch generation & verification + courier coordination if they want regular deltas.
- Emergency hotfix SLA (48h) as optional add-on (flat fee or subscription).
- HSM integration / customer-key rehearsal: professional services day-rate.

leo: Operational constraints to surface to customer:
- Delta minibundles require operator-version pinning in manifest for compatibility.
- Re-sign on key rotation is required; timeline & cost should be in SOW.
- No-telemetry builds remove remote debug; provide offline diagnostics runbook and optional on-site SE days.
- Verification requires manifest.json + signature file + public cert chain.

mike: Can we send a short acceptance checklist + exact commands SecOps can run? Keep it concise.

sarah: Sure, copy-paste checklist and commands below.

CHECKLIST:
- Verify sha256 checksum matches manifest
- Verify signature with provided CA cert
- Validate SBOM (CycloneDX) matches artifact
- Dry-run install on isolated staging node (no egress)
- Confirm telemetry flag disabled in config.yaml and effective
- Run smoke test and perform rollback validation

SAMPLE COMMANDS:
sha256sum redwood-airgap-bundle-v1.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle-v1.sig redwood-airgap-bundle-v1.tar.gz
cyclonedx-cli verify --sbom redwood-airgap-bundle-v1-sbom.json --artifact redwood-airgap-bundle-v1.tar.gz
cat manifest.json | jq '.images[] | {name, digest}'

leo: Add chain-of-custody notes: tamper-evident sealed media, serial numbers, signed courier manifest, and optional insured shipping. If they need same-day or expedited handoff, that is extra.

mike: I'll draft SecOps email with the checklist, commands, and three cadence options: (A) monthly security deltas + quarterly fulls (standard), (B) monthly minibundles (custom, incl. retainer), (C) quarterly fulls only (lower ops). Include hotfix SLA option and HSM/PS pricing.
